english.title: Driver of vehicle fail to take at least 9 hours rest in a 24 hour period - reduced rest period - AETR
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), and in the twenty four hour period commencing at **(..SPECIFY THE COMMENCEMENT TIME..) failed to take sufficient rest, when a reduced daily rest period applied, the rest taken being of less than nine hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD OF REST TAKEN..), in contravention of Article 8.1 of the European Agreement Concerning the Work of Crews of Vehicles Engaged in International Road Transport
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.
